scope:
Diagnostic only: preserve every source power reservation except MOTION_3V3; any lost 3.3 V connection or copper width must be explicitly restored before acceptance.

The R188 reservations are source-bound to the accepted R188C board.
Both terminal groups and native power/reference constraints are retained. This script permits only candidates
with an explicit native trial plan. The source reservations retain the original
trunks but do not prove moved power terminals are restored. Native
refill, all connectivity/width/reference checks and visual review are required.
